mappings.note: A school-assembly speech draft with prescribed opening and closing lines, drawing on two texts. Structured composition, so the general C-E1.2 rather than LO-6, which is specifically about writing a dated diary entry.
Why the undertaking felt strange belongs to explaining why Anne begins a diary at all, LO-3.
Whom she would let read it is a stated fact in the entry; retrieval, LO-1.
The direct form of LO-3: why she keeps a diary and what she hopes it will give her.
The name Kitty is stated; single-fact retrieval, LO-1, not the question of why she needs an invented listener.
The family sketch exists so the imagined reader can follow her - the invented-listener reasoning, LO-4.
Maths is named in the text; retrieval, LO-1.
Her talking is the stated cause of his annoyance; retrieval, LO-1.
The essay title is named in the text; retrieval, LO-1.
Dutch as the original language is a stated fact; retrieval, LO-1.
Her argument in the essay is reported in the text; extraction, LO-1.
'What shows' requires the learner to produce the detail that proves the affection - textual evidence, LO-3.
Why she felt lonely despite having friends is an inference about her inner life, LO-2, rather than a statement about the diary.
Her inability to speak of personal things is a character trait, LO-2.
The bets over who would move up a form are narrated; retrieval, LO-1.
The content of the duck-family verse is described in the text; retrieval, LO-1.
The birthday on which she received the diary is stated; retrieval, LO-1.
The published title of the book is knowledge about the work rather than content of the extract, so the competency C-E1.4.
Her reluctance to write the family sketch is part of the same reasoning about what the imagined reader needs, LO-4.
One sister, Margot, is stated in the sketch; retrieval, LO-1.
Her full name appears in the text; single-fact retrieval.
Otto Frank as the sole survivor is stated in the chapter's introductory note; retrieval, LO-1.
Margot is named in the family sketch; retrieval, LO-1.
The city where the grandmother lived is stated; retrieval, LO-1.
Her father's age at marriage is a stated figure; retrieval, LO-1.
The date heading the entry is printed in the text; retrieval, LO-1.
